steps.migration_guide: Add <Nullable>enable</Nullable> in .csproj. Fix CS8600/CS8602/CS8603 warnings. Add '?' to nullable parameters. Use null-forgiving '!' operator where safe.

steps.description: No exception handling middleware detected. Avoid try-catch in every controller — use centralized middleware
steps.migration_guide: Add centralized exception middleware instead of try-catch in every method. Create an ExceptionMiddleware class that catches unhandled exceptions, logs them with Serilog, and returns standardized error responses. Register with app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionMiddleware>().

steps.suggested_fix:
# Chiseled runtime — minimal attack surface, non-root by default
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0-noble-chiseled AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/publish .
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "MyApp.dll"]
steps.description: Not using chiseled images. .NET 10 chiseled images are ~100MB with zero shell/package manager
steps.migration_guide: Upgrade to .NET chiseled images for production. Chiseled images strip the OS to bare minimum — no shell, no package manager, no root user. Use mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0-noble-chiseled for ASP.NET or mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/runtime:10.0-noble-chiseled for console apps. ~100MB vs ~220MB regular Alpine. Already runs as non-root. Pair with PublishTrimmed + PublishAot for smallest possible image (<30MB).

steps.description: LangVersion not set to 14 or latest
steps.migration_guide: Add <LangVersion>14</LangVersion> in .csproj <PropertyGroup>. C# 14 enables extension members, first-class Span, field keyword, and more.
Migrate from Newtonsoft.Json to System.Text.Json. Replace JsonConvert with JsonSerializer. Replace [JsonProperty] with [JsonPropertyName]. Use source generators for AOT.

steps.description: No global.json found to pin SDK version
steps.migration_guide: Create global.json in repo root: run 'dotnet new globaljson --sdk-version 10.0.100'. This pins the SDK for all developers and CI.

steps.migration_guide: Add <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings> in .csproj. Remove now-implicit usings (System, System.Linq, etc.). Add custom global usings in GlobalUsings.cs.

Create Directory.Packages.props at solution root with <ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>true</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>. Move all Version= attributes from .csproj PackageReference to central file.
Add <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> in .csproj. Fix all existing warnings first. Suppress specific warnings with <NoWarn>CS1591</NoWarn> if needed.
Migrate controllers to minimal APIs: app.MapGet("/api/users", (IService svc) => svc.GetAll()). Group with MapGroup("/api/users"). Add .WithTags() for Swagger.

steps.description: No API versioning detected. Finance standard: use header-based api-version
steps.migration_guide: Add API versioning: builder.Services.AddApiVersioning(config => { config.DefaultApiVersion = new ApiVersion(1, 0); config.AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified = true; config.ReportApiVersions = true; config.ApiVersionReader = new HeaderApiVersionReader('api-version'); });
Add health checks: builder.Services.AddHealthChecks().AddDbContextCheck<AppDbContext>(); app.MapHealthChecks("/health");. Add liveness/readiness for K8s.

steps.suggested_fix:
FROM financeteamdev.azurecr.io/dotnet/sdk/custom:10.0-alpine AS build-env
FROM financeteamdev.azurecr.io/dotnet/aspnet/custom:10.0-alpine AS run-env
steps.description: Not using Finance ACR cache for base images. Use financeteamdev.azurecr.io for faster builds
steps.migration_guide: Switch FROM statements to use Finance ACR cache for faster, more reliable builds. Replace mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk with financeteamdev.azurecr.io/dotnet/sdk. Replace mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet with financeteamdev.azurecr.io/dotnet/aspnet. Use custom images from financeteamdev.azurecr.io/dotnet/sdk/custom when Azure Artifacts token is needed.

steps.description: Not configured for Native AOT publishing
steps.migration_guide: Add <PublishAot>true</PublishAot> in .csproj. Ensure no runtime reflection. Use source generators for serialization. Test with 'dotnet publish -r linux-x64'. .NET 10 improves AOT significantly.
Add <PublishTrimmed>true</PublishTrimmed> in .csproj. Fix trimming warnings with [DynamicallyAccessedMembers]. Test thoroughly. Use <TrimMode>link</TrimMode> for aggressive trimming.

steps.description: No Polly resilience library detected. Use Polly retry only for safe idempotent calls (GET, SELECT)
steps.migration_guide: Add Polly for transient fault handling. Install Polly, Polly.Extensions.Http, Polly.Contrib.WaitAndRetry. Use with HttpClientFactory: builder.Services.AddHttpClient('name').AddPolicyHandler(retryPolicy). Only retry safe operations (GET/SELECT), never retry mutations (PUT/DELETE/INSERT).

steps.description: No RuntimeIdentifier specified in project file
steps.migration_guide: Add <RuntimeIdentifier>linux-x64</RuntimeIdentifier> (or win-x64, linux-arm64) inside <PropertyGroup> in .csproj for predictable deployment builds.

steps.migration_guide: Use Span<T>/ReadOnlySpan<char> for zero-allocation parsing. Replace Substring() with AsSpan(). C# 14 adds first-class Span support in more contexts.

steps.suggested_fix: public record UserDto(string Name, string Email);
steps.migration_guide: Use record types for DTOs: 'public record UserDto(string Name, string Email);'. Provides value equality, immutability, with-expressions. Use 'record struct' for small stack types.

Add Swagger: builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer(); builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(). Use [SwaggerOperation] attributes with Summary and Description per the Finance template. Add [ProducesResponseType] for each status code.

steps.migration_guide: Convert 'namespace X { ... }' to 'namespace X;' (C# 10+). Removes one indentation level. Use IDE Quick Actions (Ctrl+.) to convert automatically.

wiki_standards.title: Docker
wiki_standards.source_page: /Finance IT/Code and Development Guidelines/Azure build pipeline best practices
wiki_standards.content_summary:
Action items:
• Use Docker@2 task for build and push with containerRegistry and tags: $(BUILD.BUILDNUMBER)
• Always use BUILD.BUILDNUMBER as docker image tag (no 'latest' in production)
• Use separate build jobs for parallel project builds when possible
• Publish artifacts to build pipeline AND storage account for deployment

wiki_standards.title: Branching
wiki_standards.content_summary:
• Where possible use rebase to get changes from master into your feature branch
• Keep commits as small as possible with good commit messages (plenty of examples of this with a quick google)
• Feature branches should be as short lived as possible
• Make more use of feature flags and hidden features to go to prod more often to reduce the life of feature branches
• Always branch from master/main
• All work should be in a branch
• When the feature is dev done create a PR for review
• Once reviewed it can move to QA

wiki_standards.title: CQRS   Coding Standards and Best Practices
wiki_standards.source_page: /Finance IT/Code and Development Guidelines/CQRS - Coding Standards and Best Practices
wiki_standards.content_summary:
Action items:
• Use Serilog with @ sign for AppInsights column names and pascal case
• Avoid try-catch in internal methods — use exception middleware for APIs
• Use Finance NuGet package for auth tokens; always get token just before HTTP call
• Use Polly retry only for safe idempotent calls (GET, SELECT)
• Use Ticketing API for generating tickets; log ticket number on AppInsights
• For large data sets, use set-based approach instead of row-by-row loops
• Docker: always compare with latest standard, use smallest image, minimal layers, use ACR cache
• Release pipelines: delete createResources.ps1 task and replace tokens task

wiki_standards.title: Code Review Process
wiki_standards.source_page: /Finance IT/Code and Development Guidelines/Code Review Process
wiki_standards.content_summary:
• Create a PR for you code changes against main/master.
• Have at least one approved code reviewer approve your code.
• Code reviews should be asynchronous (ie: create a PR so the code reviewer can do it when they are available).
• Code reviewers should make code reviews a top priority. Don't put them off til later. Do them as soon as you possibly can. (Ping the reviewer the link to your PR to make sure they know it exists)
• Keep the code reviews small by keeping the stories relatively small.
• Code reviewers goals are to keep the code clean, consistent, and efficient.
• Engineers can challenge the code review comments and request a second a reviewer if there is a disagreement on something.
